about.title: Softec Vision Ltd
about.body: We design and manufacture technology furniture as a complete system, with precise finishing and concealed cable management.
about.detail: Dimensions, displays, connections and finishes are specified around your space and equipment.
about.howBody: Every station starts as steel — cut, bent and welded to size, then finished with a durable powder coat — before its displays, controls and equipment are fitted. Cable runs stay inside the body, from a concealed access point to a clean work surface.
about.avBody: Displays, control panels, microphones and computing equipment are built into the station itself, with cable routing and access points designed in from the start rather than added on site.
about.accessBody: Where a project calls for it, we design stations at an accessible working height, with controls, microphone and connections placed within reach.
about.why1: We design and manufacture every station ourselves — from steel fabrication to full AV integration.
about.why2: Every station is engineered around your room, equipment and workflow.
about.why3: Accessibility built into the design, not added afterwards.
about.why4: Concealed cable management and an industrial-grade finish on every unit.

process.body: A structured process from requirements through on-site installation.
process.s1b: Discuss the space, display count, use and site constraints.
process.s2b: Agree dimensions, component layout and finishes with your team.
process.s3b: Cut, bend and weld the steel, then apply a powder-coated finish.
process.s4b: Fit displays and computing equipment, test functionality and install on site.
process.deliveryBody: Every station is manufactured and tested in Israel. Within Israel, our team installs and commissions it on site. For projects further afield, the station ships ready to install, with setup guidance for your team or local contractor.

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know About Our Stations
faq.body: Short answers to the questions people ask before ordering a station.
faq.a1: Lecturer, control and display stations — technology furniture with the displays, controls and computing built in. They are used in lecture halls and classrooms, conference and exhibition spaces, control and operations rooms, and industrial and testing facilities.
faq.q2: Can a station be built to our exact requirements?
faq.a2: Yes. Every station is engineered around your space, equipment and workflow. You can customise the dimensions and working height, displays and AV equipment, finish and colour, cable management and access points, mobility (fixed base or locking casters), lockable storage and accessibility requirements.
faq.q3: How much does a station cost, and how long does it take?
faq.a3: Price and lead time depend on the model, the size and how much is customised, so every project is priced individually. Tell us about your space and when you need the station, and we will come back to you with a recommendation — a catalog model or a custom solution.
faq.q4: Can you build the station around equipment we already have?
faq.a4: Yes. Dimensions, displays and connections are specified around your space and equipment. Tell us which screens, computers and control equipment you use: cable routing and access points are designed in from the start rather than added on site.
faq.q5: Do you install the station, and do you deliver outside Israel?
faq.a5: Every station is manufactured and tested in Israel. Within Israel, our team installs and commissions it on site. For projects further afield, the station ships ready to install, with setup guidance for your team or local contractor.
faq.q6: What is the process, from first contact to installation?
faq.a6: Four steps: requirements (the space, display count, use and site constraints); design and engineering (dimensions, component layout and finishes, agreed with your team); manufacturing and finishing; and finally integration and on-site installation.
faq.a7: Accessibility is built into the design, not added afterwards. Where a project calls for it, we design stations at an accessible working height, with controls, microphone and connections placed within reach.
faq.q8: What are the stations made of?
faq.a8: Steel — cut, bent and welded to size, then finished with a durable powder coat. Cable runs stay inside the body, from a concealed access point to a clean work surface.

custom.title: From Site Requirement to Finished Station
custom.body: Every project starts from a space, workflow or operational need, moves through engineering and ergonomics, and ends in an integrated, durable working environment.
custom.s1b: It begins with a room, a workflow or an operational need — with the dimensions, equipment and how the station will actually be used.
custom.s2b: We translate the need into technical and ergonomic requirements, then engineer and manufacture the station around the project.
custom.s3b: An integrated, durable and accessible working environment, installed on site and ready for daily use.
custom.c5: Mobility — fixed base or locking casters
